project: Retro Sports Arcade / EA visual evolution
methodology: All 38 screenshot URLs were traced to identified game/platform source pages and visually reviewed during research. Chromium/Playwright loaded each actual image inside reference/evolution.html (including five alternate-platform images), verified all 33 game cards, sport/era/platform/image filters and comparison controls, and captured desktop/mobile evidence on 2026-11-23. Images are remote and may be removed or block hotlinks later. Copyright and redistribution permissions are not granted by browser success.
rights_notes: EA and contributors retain rights. Screenshots are used only as attributed critical visual references. Source-site terms vary; MobyGames FAQ permits up to 20 screenshots in a credited project. Some other hosts have no documented reuse license, so conduct rights review before public distribution. A broken remote image must fall back to the source gallery.

games.title: NHL '94
games.visual_notes: Exaggerated head-and-shoulder sprites make the puck and net easy to follow; readable checks and one-timers outrank detail.
games.design_takeaway: Preserve strong silhouettes, instant directional changes, and a fixed readable play angle.
